FAQ.r1:
At CREATE TOURS CANCUN, you'll discover a wide variety of tourist destinations, excursions, and activities for your vacation. 
We have many options in our catalog, organized by general categories such as Archaeological Zones and Theme Parks, with specific subcategories such as Chichén Itzá and Xcaret. 
Choose the tour you're interested in, click 'Book,' select the date, number of travelers, and desired time. 
Complete a simple form, make the payment, and you'll receive confirmation of your purchase. 
Subsequently, you'll receive your boarding pass by email with details of the activity.
FAQ.r2: Print the pass or bring it on your phone, read the terms and conditions, and take it with you on the tour. It is mandatory to present the pass on the day of the event. Find details such as the pickup time and meeting point on the pass. If you have any doubts, contact us by phone or chat.
FAQ.r3: It is not necessary. We accept payments with debit cards, credit cards, and PayPal. Additionally, we offer alternatives through our call center for payments in Mexican territory, including bank window, electronic transfer, deposit in OXXO stores, and deferred payments.
FAQ.r4: Yes, Create Tours guarantees the security of your data. We have a security certificate that encrypts your information before reaching our databases. Your privacy is our priority.

You will live a unique experience. 
A guided tour to the world-famous archaeological site of Chichen Itzá, located on the Yucatán Peninsula, Mexico. 
Chichen Itzá holds the title of one of the 7 wonders of the modern world and has been named a UNESCO World Heritage Site.

Tour departure from our base.
Brief stop at the highway booth if necessary, before embarking on our journey through the Mayan roads to go to the bathroom 
(Note: Buses have their own bathroom, but you might need a little space after an hour of travel).

🕛11:00 am
Arrival at Villa Maya, where we will perform the healing ceremony led by the 'Mayan Shaman'; 
Visit the craft store, where you will find authentic works of art made by local artisans.
Tasting of artisanal Tequilas of different flavors, 100% original product. 
Visit to our restaurant 'Yaax Kiin'. Our Maya chef will delight us with a buffet of regional cuisine.
(13Baktun has its own restaurant, with the widest variety of dishes included in our buffet).

🕐13:00 hrs
2.30 Hrs Visit to the archaeological site of Chichén Itzá. 
You will learn about how the Maya lived back then, the history of the most important buildings in that magnificent city,
 including its myths, legends, and much culture.
Guided service (in English or Spanish), and then you will have time to walk on your own in the surroundings

🔹The archaeological site has few facilities for wheelchair access.

Brief visit to the main square of the city of Valladolid, Yucatán. Here you can have a small taste of what this beautiful city offers.

Ask your guide about 'esquites,' 'ice cream,' and 'marquesitas' – they are delicious!

Return to your starting point, drop-off at your hotel or meeting point.

Relax on Xel Ha's hidden beach, swim in cenotes and lagoons, practice snorkeling and spelunking in caves. 

Be careful with wildlife such as angelfish and iguanas. Xel-Há is all-inclusive, so enjoy Maya cuisine, seafood, and burgers with your admission.

This tour is ideal for families and includes round-trip transportation to Xel-Há from Cancun.

Discover caves, cenotes, a hanging bridge, and a hidden beach.

After morning pickup at your hotel in Cancun, travel to Xel Há for a day of exploration and discovery.
After a scenic 1.5-hour drive through Mexico, arrive at Xel-Há, located in a bay on the Riviera Maya. 
Pick up your all-inclusive bracelet and get to work exploring.

Cycle, ride a tram, or walk to the top of the river in Xel Ha. 
Check safety instructions before jumping into an inner tube and floating past mangroves to a spot where you can cliff dive.

Stroll through the network of paved trails, where you can observe Mexico's wildlife variety, such as iguanas and tropical birds. 
Reach caves, a floating bridge, and a hidden beach.

Apply some biodegradable sunscreen, available on-site and necessary to preserve the park's ecology, before immersing yourself in the lagoon. Put on the provided snorkeling gear to see rays and angelfish swimming around you.

Stop at the buffet, sit-down restaurant, or any of the park's bars for lunch or a quick bite. Enjoy unlimited drinks from the bar during your stay.
At the end of your ecological adventure, you'll return to Cancun to be dropped off at your hotel.

viaje6.intinerario:
After being picked up at your hotel in Cancun or the central meeting point, travel comfortably and air-conditioned to Xcaret Park on the outskirts of Cancun. 

This Xcaret tour offers activities for all interests, from history to ecology and adventure. 

Explore the underground caves beneath the jungle, once used by the Maya for cleansing rituals, before sailing to Cozumel Island, a sacred site.

Keep an eye out for macaws, deer, and brightly colored monkeys as you navigate the network of underground tunnels. 

Discover the orchid garden, a favorite of nature lovers and amateur botanists. 

Check out the butterfly pavilion and aviary, as well as the aquarium with specimens of beautiful coral reefs. 

Head to the beach to relax, swim in the warm and calm waters, or snorkel with sea turtles.

 Most of these activities are included in your admission to Xcaret. 

Prices for additional activities may vary. 
If you want to extend your outing to Xcaret in Cancun, stay for Xcaret México Espectacular, a show full of folk entertainment, dances, and music.
 
Follow the narrative of Mexican history from pre-Columbian times to modern times through the artists. 

Xcaret Plus Upgrade: 
Enjoy a buffet lunch, including orange juice and lemonade. 
Use snorkeling equipment to explore Xcaret's waters more thoroughly in Cancun, Mexico, and receive access to the Plus Area, which includes more exclusive and private dressing and shower areas. 
At the end of the day, enjoy the drop-off at your Cancun hotel.

This tour offers a unique experience, taking you to two different archaeological sites full of magic and traditions, Tulúm and Cobá. 
Another spectacular part of this journey is the cenote 'Muul´Ichi Ts´ono´ot.' 

Finally, on this adventure, we will visit one of the 25 most popular destinations in the world according to TripAdvisor, the warm and fantastic Fifth Avenue within the city of Playa del Carmen. (More details below).

'Cenote Muul´Ichi Ts´ono´ot':

This beautiful cenote, nestled in the jungle and accompanied by the cheerful concert of birds, was discovered over 100 years ago by chiclero ancestors. 

It is the source of income for the community 'San Juan de Dios,' located near the Cobá Archaeological Zone. 
Its name, translated from Maya to Spanish, means 'ruin in cenotes' because inside, there are ruins in the form of a pyramid built by the ancient Mayas. 

The cenote has a vaulted dome with a small opening and scarce sunlight. 
Descend a spiral staircase to a wooden platform where tree roots hang down, creating a magical place with fresh and crystalline waters that entice you to enjoy a good swim.

Here, we will take a one-hour walk on its famous and traditional 'Fifth Avenue,' which is visited by thousands of tourists from all over the world.
On the 'Fifth Avenue,' an infinity of very picturesque themed shops are displayed, with very striking styles, from a tropical restaurant to a café that seems to have been taken from a street in Paris.

viaje14.descripcion: Embark on aquatic adventures with this jungle excursion in Cancun. Get your adrenaline pumping on a high-speed boat ride around Laguna Nichupté, and slow down with serene snorkeling over the underwater statues at the Punta Nizuc coral reef. Colorful marine life and brilliant blue waters await you. A guide is present at all times to ensure you enjoy your excursion.

viaje14.intinerario:
Check-in half an hour before departure

First, you will receive your locker where you should keep everything you don't want to get wet.

Then, join your group and receive a warm welcome from the guide. Once you have received instructions, board your boat and start driving towards Punta Nizuc.

Pass through the mangrove jungle and reach the seaside where you will stop and snorkel.

After snorkeling around the reef, board your boat again and return to Aquaworld for more activities. This tour lasts two hours.

viaje16.descripcion: Join Captain Black Jack and his pirate crew aboard the Jolly Roger on their quest for the Golden Fleece treasure. The adventure will begin as soon as you arrive at the Playa Linda dock in the Hotel Zone of Cancun. There, the pirate hosts of Jolly Roger will be eagerly waiting to greet you. Be sure to look for the impressive Jolly Roger pirate ship as you enter the port. Take a souvenir photo with some friendly pirates as soon as you board the pirate ship and remember the special day forever. Once on the deck, a personal pirate waiter will be waiting for you. Quench your thirst with a dazzling selection of drinks, including beers, cocktails, wine, and non-alcoholic beverages. Before you know it, the real fun will begin, and you'll be standing, dancing, laughing, and working up an appetite for your delicious gourmet meal. The Galleon 112 is an authentic replica of Christopher Columbus's Santa Maria used on his initial journey to the Americas in the 16th century. Onboard, you'll feel like you've stepped back in time to the Golden Age of piracy.

viaje18.descripcion: The Garrafon Natural Reef Park is located on the beautiful island of Isla Mujeres. It is well-known worldwide for its stunning reefs and cliffs right in front of the turquoise waters of the Mexican Caribbean Sea. Just 25 minutes from Cancun, this reef park offers recreational activities such as snorkeling, kayaking, zip-lining, and island tours. It also provides relaxation activities like Mayan sauna (Temazcal), a panoramic pool, and sun loungers. Come and experience what Garrafon Natural Reef Park has for you and gather incredible memories that will last forever.

Cancun awaits you with the most paradisiacal beaches in the world! Are you planning to spend your next vacation here and have a great experience? Then you need to swim with dolphins in Isla Mujeres, one of the favorite activities among Cancun visitors.

We created the Dolphin Encounter program for people of all ages. Dolphin Discovery-Isla Mujeres is just a 20-minute ferry ride away in Isla Mujeres, an island with one of the most beautiful landscapes in the Caribbean Sea.

The incredible part of this program is that you will actually swim with the most adorable marine animals in their natural Caribbean habitat! You don't need to be a professional swimmer to get the best dolphin experience; you'll be standing at all times on an underwater platform where our beloved dolphins will give you a beautiful hug and a handshake.

Dolphins are always excited to play with our visitors and share their amazing skills and friendly company. While standing on the underwater platform, our marine mammal specialists will teach you some interesting facts about dolphins, their diet, and the reproductive and nursing programs we obtain for our species, as well as special tips to protect our environment.

Enjoy the rest of the day in our two incredible pools, or relax in the sun. Savor a delicious buffet and get refreshing drinks from the national open bar in the company of your family and friends. Don't hesitate! If you want to have fun with your loved ones, Dolphin Discovery-Isla Mujeres is the best choice for you!

08:00 am 
Departure on the Tour from our base. 
Brief stop at the highway toll booth if necessary before embarking on our journey through the Mayan roads to 'the restroom' (Note: Buses have their own bathroom, but you may need some space after an hour of travel)  
 
11:00 am 
Arrival at Villa Maya, where we will perform the healing ceremony conducted by the 'Mayan Shaman'; Visit to the craft store, where you will find authentic works of art made by local artisans.  
Tasting of artisanal tequilas of different flavors, 100% original product. Visit to our restaurant 'Yaax Kiin'. Our Maya chef will delight us with a buffet of regional food (13Baktun has its own restaurant, with the widest variety of dishes included in our buffet).  
 
13:00 hrs  
2.30 Hrs of Visit to the archaeological site of Chichén Itzá. You will learn how the Mayas lived back then, the history of the most important buildings of that grand city, including its myths, legends, and much culture. Guided service (in English or Spanish) and then you will have time to walk on your own in the surroundings and take the best photos of your Chichen Itzá Tour.

16:30 hrs
